MikroTik RB951Ui-2nD (hAP) – High-Performance Home & Office Wireless Router

Reliable & Affordable WiFi Router with 2.4GHz Wireless, 5 LAN Ports & PoE Support

The MikroTik RB951Ui-2nD (hAP) is a powerful and cost-effective wireless router, designed for home and small office networks. Featuring a 650MHz CPU, 64MB RAM, and 16MB FLASH storage, it delivers seamless performance for stable internet connectivity.


With 5 x LAN ports, built-in 2.4GHz 802.11b/g/n WiFi (dual-chain, 300Mbps), and integrated 1.5 dBi antennas, this router is ideal for fast and reliable wireless networking. The USB port and Passive PoE input add flexibility for advanced networking and power options.


Key Features 

  • High-Performance Networking – 650MHz CPU for smooth and efficient operation.
  • Strong Wireless Coverage – Built-in 2.4GHz 802.11b/g/n dual-chain WiFi (300 Mbps) with integrated 1.5 dBi antennas for stable and reliable connectivity.
  • Multiple LAN Connections – 5 x Fast Ethernet LAN ports for wired networking devices.
  • USB Port – Supports storage, modem, and additional network functionalities.
  • Passive PoE Support – PoE input allows for flexible installation with power-over-Ethernet support.
  • Advanced RouterOS L4 Features – Firewall, VPN, bandwidth management, and security options.
  • Compact & Stylish Design – Lightweight, space-saving plastic case for home or office use.
  • Trusted MikroTik Quality – Manufactured by Mikrotikls SIA (Latvia), made in Latvia, Lithuania, or China.
  • 12-Month Limited Warranty – Ensures reliability and peace of mind.


Technical Specifications

  • Brand: MikroTik
  • Model: RB951Ui-2nD (hAP)
  • CPU: 650MHz
  • RAM: 64MB
  • Storage: 16MB FLASH
  • Ethernet Ports: 5 x 10/100 Mbps LAN Ports
  • WiFi: 2.4GHz 802.11b/g/n, Dual Chain (300Mbps)
  • Antenna: Integrated 1.5 dBi antennas
  • USB Port: Yes
  • PoE Support: Passive PoE (PoE In)
  • Operating System: RouterOS L4
  • Power Supply: Adapter included
  • Enclosure: Plastic case
  • Manufacturing Origin: Latvia, Lithuania, or China
  • Warranty: 12-Month Limited Warranty

Ideal Applications

  • Home Networking – Stable and fast WiFi & wired connections for daily internet usage.
  • Small Offices & Startups – Reliable and cost-effective networking solution.
  • Apartments & Dorms – Compact design for easy placement.
  • Smart Home & IoT – Connect smart devices, security cameras, and automation systems.
  • VPN & Secure Networking – Supports advanced security features with MikroTik RouterOS.


Why Choose MikroTik RB951Ui-2nD (hAP)?

  • Affordable & Feature-Rich – Excellent value for home and small business networking.
  • Strong WiFi Performance – Dual-chain 2.4GHz wireless (300Mbps) for seamless connectivity.
  • Flexible Connectivity – 5 LAN ports, USB, and PoE input for multiple use cases.
  • Reliable & Durable – MikroTik’s high-quality networking technology ensures long-term performance.
